evals.name: visible-actions
evals.prompt: Build a shelf toolbar that draws shelves in draw mode and notes in review mode.
evals.expected_output: The screen mode selects the named context.
assertions: Sets ToolbarSection.activeContext to the application's mode.
Matches the ToolbarContext names to those modes.
Supplies each ToolbarButton with visible text or icon as well as title and onClick.

evals.name: keyboard
evals.prompt: Make the shelf toolbar one Tab stop, with arrow navigation inside it.
assertions: Distinguishes it from the default Arrows mode retaining individual Tab stops.

evals.name: reset-state
evals.prompt: Changing tool modes must discard an unfinished book note. Why does unmount cleanup not run?
evals.expected_output: Inactive contexts remain mounted but inert.
assertions: Identifies that the inactive context is hidden, not unmounted.
Resets application state explicitly when changing mode.
Keeps the active mode name aligned with the context name.
